name: lazy-typescript-lsp
description: TypeScript language server for the LSP tool that starts only on an LSP request and stops when idle

server.title: Language server command
server.description: Command that starts an LSP server over stdio, such as `tsrs --lsp --stdio`. It runs in the project directory with node_modules/.bin on PATH. Leave empty to start TypeScript 7 from the project (@typescript/native, then @typescript/native-preview).
